command:
source /workspace/env.sh
exec python -c 'import json,yaml
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('"'"'/work'"'"')
upstream=yaml.safe_load((root/'"'"'repo/examples/training_demo/jt_deepseek_v3/hp_4k_1_card.yaml'"'"').read_text())
for suffix in ('"'"'0-200'"'"','"'"'200-400'"'"','"'"'continuous400'"'"'):
    path=root/'"'"'configs'"'"'/('"'"'r129-f637-fp32-fsdp8-'"'"'+suffix+'"'"'.yaml'"'"')
    config=yaml.safe_load(path.read_text())
    assert config['"'"'plan_overrides'"'"']==upstream['"'"'plan_overrides'"'"']
    assert config['"'"'model'"'"']['"'"'config'"'"']['"'"'enable_chunk_loss'"'"'] is True
    assert config['"'"'model'"'"']['"'"'config'"'"']['"'"'chunk_loss_size'"'"']==4096
    assert '"'"'loss_chunk_size'"'"' not in config['"'"'model'"'"']['"'"'config'"'"']
    assert config['"'"'model'"'"']['"'"'config'"'"']['"'"'expert_fp32_weight_gradients'"'"'] is True
    assert config['"'"'optimizer'"'"']['"'"'muon_config'"'"']['"'"'ns_dtype'"'"']=='"'"'float32'"'"'
    assert config['"'"'training'"'"']['"'"'train_iters'"'"']==(200 if suffix=='"'"'0-200'"'"' else 400)
    assert config['"'"'checkpoint'"'"']['"'"'save_ckpt'"'"']==(suffix=='"'"'0-200'"'"')
    assert config['"'"'checkpoint'"'"']['"'"'restore_from'"'"']==('"'"'/work/checkpoints/r129-f637-fp32-fsdp8/global_step_200'"'"' if suffix=='"'"'200-400'"'"' else None)
    assert config['"'"'fsdp_config'"'"']['"'"'dp_shard_size'"'"']==8
    print(json.dumps({'"'"'config'"'"':path.name,'"'"'validated'"'"':True}))
'
